title: In-Person Appointments Booking Deposit: Lead-Time Table
content:
**Lead-time table for the booking deposit, In-Person Appointments.** The booking deposit on a visit changes with how far ahead the visit was booked, counted as the days from the booking date to the scheduled date:

| Days from booking date to scheduled date | Effect on the booking deposit |
|---|---|
| 45 or more | 25.00 dollars are taken off the booking deposit |
| 14 to 44 | The booking deposit is not changed for its booking lead |
| fewer than 14 | 50.00 dollars are added to the booking deposit |

The booking date is the date the booking was made, as shown on the appointment record.

**Band edges (hypothetical dates, visit scheduled 2026-12-15).**

- Booked 2026-10-31: 45 days, so 25.00 dollars are taken off. Booked 2026-11-01: 44 days, no change.
- Booked 2026-12-01: 14 days, no change. Booked 2026-12-02: 13 days, so 50.00 dollars are added.
